mapper.insert: INSERT INTO market_data (task_id, category, source, raw_data, last_verified, freshness_ttl_days, freshness_status, weight, trace_id, gmt_create, gmt_modified) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{category}, #{source}, #{rawData, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{lastVerified, jdbcType=DATE}, #{freshnessTtlDays}, #{freshnessStatus}, #{weight, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{traceId}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE source = VALUES(source), raw_data = VALUES(raw_data), last_verified = VALUES(last_verified), freshness_ttl_days = VALUES(freshness_ttl_days), freshness_status = VALUES(freshness_status), weight = VALUES(weight), trace_id = VALUES(trace_id), gmt_modified = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id, category, source, raw_data, last_verified, freshness_ttl_days, freshness_status, weight, trace_id, gmt_create, gmt_modified FROM market_data WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY id
